name: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd
about: Aurobindo Pharma is principally engaged in manufacturing and marketing of active pharmaceutical ingredients, generic pharmaceuticals and related services.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:159)
keyPoints: Leading Pharmaceutical Company:.[1] The company is India’s 3rd-largest listed pharma company based on revenue & the largest generics company in the US. It is ranked among the top 10 generic companies in 8 European countries
cons: Stock is trading at 2.62 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.32% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 10.8% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
